verdict.rationale: SumUp's docs describe sandbox merchant accounts and a full set of test cards for simulating successful, failed and 3D Secure payment flows. Virtual Solo lets you test the in-person pairing and checkout flow on a sandbox account before switching to a physical reader, so testing stays out of production. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the MCP server or Agent Toolkit can target sandbox accounts or keys, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox.
